results.title: Tagar
results.overview: Tagor is a kind-hearted, selfless young man who stands fearlessly against injustice and loves the brave Joyita deeply. The enemies take their revenge on Joyita. Can Tagor save both his love and justice?

results.title: ACA 187: Polpudnikov vs. Matmuratov 2
results.overview: ACA 187: Polpudnikov vs. Matmuratov 2 was a mixed martial arts event that took place on Friday, June 6, 2025 at the Basket Hall in Moscow, Russia.

results.title: Peak Confrontation
results.overview: Chu Tiankuo, who was born as a gangster, was framed to participate in the gambling king competition to win the golden mask. During the competition, he was framed and rescued by a princess of an alien tribe and accidentally got the clue of the golden mask. Unexpectedly, the various people who were looking for the mask got the news and waited for an opportunity to move. A peak confrontation immediately kicked off at the border. During the confrontation, Chu Tiankuo also accidentally learned about his father's experience. For his father and his own mission, Chu Tiankuo resolutely threw himself into the battle.

results.title: MEAT MACHINE
results.overview: The atomic-bomb is about to be dropped on a small Texas town

results.title: The Legend of Nigel Kneale: Enemy From Space
results.original_title: The Legend of Nigel Kneale: Enemy From Space
results.overview: Blending expert testimony with newly contextualised archive, Enemy from Space reveals how Kneale’s ideas about authority, alienation and technological dread still ripple through today’s genre cinema and TV. The result is a concluding chapter that’s both celebration and re-appraisal. designed to cap the Hammer box set with a thoughtful, contemporary perspective on a towering, sometimes misunderstood figure.

results.title: Wrestle-Off
results.overview: Tenacious high school wrestler Alex battles with the grief of her father’s passing and the hostility of her teammates as she fiercely competes for a varsity spot on an all-male wrestling team.

results.title: Room for a Break
results.overview: Room for a Break explores changes in our working life through everyday spaces. The film depicts breaks in a think tank, construction site container, museum, and midwife break room, among others. A break expands into a question of space and time: who can take a break in today’s work life, in what kind of settings are breaks taken, and who decides on breaks?

results.title: Robbers
results.overview: Inspired by a viral theft trend, a wannabe musician schemes to afford studio time by convincing his bassist to burglarize a small business—but someone else might have the same idea.

results.title: Mesmerized
results.overview: A young woman returns to the mountain where her family spent their childhood summers in search of the sister that only she can remember.

results.title: Act for three
results.overview: On opening night of a play about addiction and rupture, three actors confront a secret romantic conflict they have long kept hidden. When a betrayal is exposed onstage, the line between fiction and reality shatters, turning the performance into a real confrontation that threatens to destroy everything.

results.title: Because Today is Saturday
results.overview: A woman wakes up early because she wants to give herself a gift: time. But each spark of inspiration is cut short by household responsibilities that demand her attention, the children, the laundry, the meals. The mental load of these tasks becomes unbearable, and she reaches a breaking point.

results.title: The Informant
results.overview: Tae-bong, an informant in a smuggling operation, gets exposed during his mission. Meanwhile, bumbling detective Nam-hyuk stumbles into the chaos while attempting his own scheme. Forced into an uneasy alliance, the two must recover their losses and take down the criminals.

results.title: Chicken House
results.overview: A reclusive man has just moved to the suburbs when he begins to receive visits from strangers dressed in homemade chicken costumes. When he discovers the truth about his new house, he must confront both the chicken people and his own trauma.

results.title: The Lonely Warrior
results.overview: Retired soldier Gao Feng, in search of his missing brother, ventures solo into the depths of the jungle in Longsai Town. With the help of A Jie, Li Yushan, A Ya, and others, he foils a massive conspiracy by an extremist organization to develop super mutants.

results.title: Um quarto de bronze
results.overview: A bronze figure declares his love to a woman, Isabel. Isabel recognises her inability to reciprocate this feeling and to surrender to this relationship. This story is staged by a Third Person, in a closed room with no time, in an atmosphere of urgent search for perfection in the performances of the two interpreters. The Third Person is, in turn, observed by a Fourth Person.

results.title: Frosted Window
results.overview: In Seoul's Seochon neighborhood, stories unfold across seasons. On an autumn day, Han-kyung, an artist, meets women while seeking love. In summer, Bo-ra finishes work at a nail salon and uses a man to attract another at her favorite bar. In winter, Ma-ri, an actor with memory loss, joins a film director's ambiguous story. Their lives intersect, weaving a tapestry of hope, desire, and reality within the same space over time.

results.title: Taco Boy
results.overview: Seven-year-old Maggie desperately wants to get her elderly dog, Taco, a cake for his upcoming birthday. As her mother repeatedly refuses, Maggie learns her reason for not wanting to order one.

results.title: Burning Light
results.overview: The Searcher and The Spark meet.

results.title: Reunion
results.overview: A selfish son returns to see his estranged father, only to discover something sinister.
